integrity: All displayed formulas were derived from the cited published martingale formula; numerical constants are reproducible from the bundled standard-library verifier. Literature searches support noncoverage but do not establish exhaustive novelty.
scientific_limitations: The result is a pointwise envelope for the published fixed-precision Gaussian-mixture scale-invariant martingale in the one-dimensional Gaussian mean problem. The data-dependent supremum is not asserted to preserve e-validity, and no claim is made for other sequential t-test constructions or multivariate mixtures.
title: A sharp oracle tuning envelope for Gaussian-mixture sequential \(t\)-martingales
